title: glab api projects/${project}/issues?${query} [--paginate]
description: The project's issues, ${project} its path URL-encoded: the open ones with their labels' details, ${query} state=opened&per_page=100&order_by=created_at&sort=asc&with_labels_details=true with --paginate, which print one such array per page, in `modules/bash/forge/gitlab.sh` (forge/gitlab:open-issues, with `modules/jq/forge.jq` forge::gitlab_issues), and the one updated last, ${query} order_by=updated_at&sort=desc&per_page=1, whose iid and updated_at kit reads (forge/gitlab:marks, with forge::gitlab_marks). The types are APIEntitiesIssue of GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/issues in GitLab's REST OpenAPI, https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/raw/master/doc/api/openapi/openapi_v3.yaml, and a label's details those with_labels_details gives at https://docs.gitlab.com/api/issues/.

iid.description: The issue's number in its project.

labels.description: Each label's name, or with with_labels_details=true each label's details.

color.description: A 6-digit hex color with a leading #, or a CSS color name.

full.description: The issue's reference with its project's full path, as group/project#7.
